doc: Per-frame damage-over-time / status processor. Unless D_80073828[0] is set (global suppression), iterates the first D_80073734[0] entries in D_80085458. For each entry whose f1a counter is nonzero, queries func_8005EB78(D_80073740[i]); if it returns 3, either increments f1a (while f1a<2) or, once f1a has reached 2, OR-accumulates D_80073740[i] into a local `flags` value and repeatedly calls func_8005E97C(0, D_80073740[i]) until func_8005EB78(D_80073740[i]) reports 0 (done) or 2 (cancelled), then clears f1a. After the loop, if any flags were accumulated, broadcasts them once via func_8005E97C(0, flags).

globals.name: D_80073734

func_8005E97C(s32 a0, s32 a1) -> void  // broadcasts flags a1 with mode a0
